Benewake launches NOVA20 for near-field robot sensing

A 20-point sensor covers 0.05–1 metre as a complement to cameras and longer-range LiDAR.

Benewake / PRNewswire ↗12 October 2026English editorial summary
StoryImages 1

Closing a near-field gap

Benewake introduced NOVA20 for the metre surrounding a robot, complementing longer-range LiDAR and cameras that the robot’s body can obscure. It outputs physical distance measurements rather than two-dimensional images.

Compact solid-state sensing

Specifications list 20 detection points, a 40-degree field of view, 0.05–1 metre range, weight below 5 grams and power below 1 watt. The one-metre specification assumes 10% target reflectivity under 100-klux lighting.

Applications and system limits

Proposed uses include wall-following, detecting stairs or drop-offs, and slowing before contact with people. Sensors can sit on chassis or limbs. These component claims do not establish that a complete robot automatically meets safety requirements.
